results.content:
I started building Agent Profiles after months of searching for a simple way to manage my AI agents across tools.   
  
The performance of Openclaw and the ability to wake up an Agent that immediately knows who it is, it's history, and what it needs to do next, always left me wanting more from my other AI sessions!  
  
I just wanted a job done, and I want it done well - without starting from scratch every time I open a new Agent chat.  
  
So now you can (and a lot more!) with one login and across all your AI agents!  
Claude, codex, OpenClaw, Hermes, connect them all!  
  
Feel free to:  
- Try Agent Profiles for free  
- Make an Agent's page public and share a post!

#### What's great

Vokal makes AI agent work feel much more collaborative and organized. Instead of having context, tasks, and outputs scattered across private chats or separate tools, everything happens in a shared real-time workspace.

What I like most is that humans and agents can coordinate before the final output is delivered. It makes the work easier to review, easier to follow, and easier to reuse later.

#### vs Alternatives

SlackSlackGitHubGitHubChatGPT by OpenAIChatGPT by OpenAI [...] Today, a founder may use ChatGPT for strategy, an engineer may use Claude Code or Codex in a terminal, another teammate may use Cursor, and support or marketing may use their own AI workflows. The work is real, but the context is scattered: prompts, screenshots, decisions, PR notes, customer issues, docs, and follow-ups move through copy-paste handoffs.

Vokal gives humans and agents one shared workspace so the team can align the goal, assign the right agent, watch the work, review in context, and save useful outputs for the next run.
